about: Homepage project cards. Any public paperhurts repo tagged with the GitHub topic below shows up automatically, using its description and main language. Entries here are optional: they pin the order and polish the card copy. `extra` holds cards for things that aren't public repos.

gitmarks.label: chrome + firefox · web
gitmarks.blurb: Serverless cross-browser bookmark sync. Your bookmarks live in your own private GitHub repo — no server, no backend, your data.

server-start.label: windows tray · rust
server-start.blurb: Manage dev servers from the task tray — start, stop, and restart any project's processes without hunting for terminals. One .exe, zero dependencies.

window-snap.label: windows tray · rust
window-snap.blurb: Custom window layouts for Windows 11 — one hotkey arranges your whole desktop, because snap layouts should be better.

claude-recall.label: cli · python
claude-recall.blurb: Back up your Claude conversations — messages, thinking blocks, metadata — to a local SQLite database you own.

doc-md.label: desktop + mobile · tauri
doc-md.blurb: Local-first markdown knowledge base — an Obsidian alternative. Plain files on disk, no proprietary formats, no cloud lock-in.

waterways.label: web · typescript + python
waterways.blurb: Where north Florida's rain goes: animated maps of every creek, spring, and sink between the Suwannee and the St. Johns, rebuilt from USGS data.

extra.name: paperhurts-reader
extra.label: pwa + ios · self-hosted
extra.blurb: Distraction-free fanfiction reader — share a link from your phone to import, read offline, listen with lock-screen TTS. A self-hosted PWA with a native iOS app.
